versions.content: Meaning of DiagnosticIOControl . dataIdentifier The DiagnosticIOControl . dataIdentifier is taken for specifying the payload for the service. However, in some cases dataIdentifier models the payload of the request mes- sage ( DiagnosticIOControl . shortTermAdjustment is set to true) and in some cases it represents the payload of the response message.
